# Calibration vs Jev (generated by benchmarks/v2/calibration_report.py)

Calibrators were fitted on the 200 gold dev examples only (out-of-sample predictions of the deployed model) and frozen before one logged test scoring. Choice/Score heads use argmax-preserving calibrators only (none/temperature); Noul heads any monotone map, with decisions at the frozen threshold on the raw probability. Decisions and accuracy are unchanged by calibration. *Ours* = served predictions (batch size 1, `b1` marks tasks whose int8 test predictions were re-computed one request at a time). *Oracle* rows recalibrate each system by 5-fold CV on the test labels with the same allowed methods (an upper bound, identical for both systems). ECE: 10 equal-width bins, top-label; ACE: 10 equal-mass bins.
